name: El Boalo (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white triangle with its base along the lower edge and its apex at the middle of the upper edge, charged with the crowned municipal arms of El Boalo (a crown on wavy blue and white, and bars with the words AVE MARIA).
history: El Boalo adopted its arms and flag officially on 30 June 1994, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 27 July 1994.
